chunks: Those who spend their wealth in the way of God, by night and by day, in secret and openly, for them is their reward with their Lord, and there will be no fear for them, nor will they grieve.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who spend their wealth in the way of God secretly and openly?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the virtue of *sadaqah* (charity) performed with sincerity, transcending the need for public recognition. It underscores the spiritual security of the faithful, promising them divine reward free from the anxiety of loss or the regret of missed opportunities, a concept deeply linked to the concept of *Rida* (divine pleasure).
